description: Issue #164: the L4 loop guard compares the VIOLATIONS, not the first 20 lines of the scope gate's logTail. #201's scope gate names 22 out-of-scope paths on turn 1 and 22 again on turn 2, identical except for the last three — the worker really did move, and the change falls OUTSIDE the 20-line display window. Before the fix the window was applied before the dedup/sort that builds the comparison set, so the two turns compared equal and a converging worker was cut off with scope_unsatisfiable on turn 2. Here it is re-instructed as before (3 sends under --max-turns 5), the wave advances and #200 is dispatched. The bounded message still says what it left out ('ほか 3 行'), and the worker record keeps the fact that it did.
